text:
The Toil & Trouble file doesn't record any earlier matters, so I can't give you a list of what it has used before. What follows comes only from this matter (Okafor, B-2), and it's what you can expect to see in the production.

**Internal systems and sources**
- **Ravenscar ticketing system:** where the client tracks complaints. The complaint reports due June 5 should come out of it.
- **Quality records for the Q3-2024 production period:** available on request through Mr. Oyelaran. Rennick Odell, the product safety lead, is the technical contact.
- **Line inspection records:** limited by agreement to the week of manufacture of the Q3-2024 lot units.
- **July 2025 gasket shipment records:** not yet pulled.

**Document and product identifiers**
- **PressureMate TT-6200:** the six-quart unit at issue.
- **TT-5500:** shares the lockout pin but has a different ring and lid seat. It is in scope only where a report names the pin as the failing element.
- **Lot Q3-2024:** the lot plaintiff's counsel attributes the unit to.
- **ECN-6200-14:** the engineering change notice adding a retention clip to the lockout pin. It will be in the design file.
- **Cause No. D-2026-1184:** the court's cause number.

**Code names**
None appear in the file.

**Earlier matters**
If you need the client's naming conventions from past work, ask Mr. Oyelaran or Mr. Odell for a key to the Ravenscar fields and the lot and ECN numbering. Do this through Mr. Oyelaran, since we shouldn't contact client employees directly. I haven't used material from the firm's other client matters. Their systems and identifiers belong to those clients and shouldn't be used here.
